title: The MCP dogfood close check fails when the engram mcp server takes over 10s to exit under host load
outcome: The MCP dogfood close check fails when the engram mcp server takes over 10s to exit under host load
acceptance: Retained bounded trace-on/off baseline/load measurements distinguish what was observed from unmeasured shutdown stages; the original post-deadline sampler contribution is measured and removed; no causal attribution is made without evidence; and the close check now records the shutdown-stage milestones and pre-EOF load needed to attribute the next occurrence.
Then either shutdown is made bounded, or the close check distinguishes a late clean exit under measured host saturation from a hung server, without loosening the budget for a hung server
The MCP dogfood suite passes in the full gate

Removed blocking post-deadline sampler. Historical measurements retained with causal limits; original stage/cause remains unknown.
